title: Figures 10-11: Laser beam power attenuation and captured power vs laser wavelength
description: Two line graphs plotting fraction of radiated power captured by the Lightcraft against laser wavelength/optimum laser wavelength (0-7). Figure 10, "Attenuation Effects on Captured Laser Beam Power [26]", contrasts beam power attenuation due to diffraction alone with diffraction plus atmospheric effects. Figure 11, "Influence of Trajectory and Laser Wavelength on Captured Power [26]", compares the Earth-to-orbit trajectory, end of laser airbreathing propulsion, and end of airbreathing and rocket propulsion.
